document.title: Wikimedia Enterprise
document.attribution: Meta-Wiki contributors and the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise
individuals.description: The Wikimedia Foundation's offering of data services for organizations that reuse Wikimedia content at scale.

evidence.quote: **Wikimedia Enterprise** is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com.
The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: Paid Enterprise API access
individuals.description: Contracted access to the Enterprise APIs for large commercial organisations, with SLAs and dedicated customer support.

evidence.quote: The *primary* use case of the suite of Enterprise APIs is paid access for large commercial organisations, with associated Service Level Agreements and dedicated customer support.

individuals.title: Free Enterprise API access
individuals.description: Access to the Enterprise APIs at no cost through a free account, with lower rates and less frequent snapshots.

evidence.quote: Creating a free account on the official website and using the Enterprise API access for free accounts.

individuals.title: Exceptional access
individuals.description: Free access to the higher, paid rate of the Enterprise APIs for mission-aligned uses, granted at the Foundation's discretion.

evidence.quote: you may request free **exceptional access** to the higher rate of the Enterprise APIs

individuals.title: Customer support
individuals.description: Support for account holders, with response-time guarantees for contracted accounts; provided with PartnerHero.

evidence.quote: **PartnerHero** provide customer support services
dedicated customer support

individuals.title: Service Level Agreement
individuals.description: The agreement attached to paid accounts: a 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees.

evidence.quote: Contracted accounts receive 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees.
with associated Service Level Agreements

individuals.title: Terms of Use
individuals.description: The Wikimedia Foundation terms that apply to every use of the service.

evidence.quote: including the Terms of Use, the User-Agent Policy

individuals.title: API Usage guidelines
individuals.description: The usage guidelines for the Enterprise APIs, including the rules on sub-licensing.

evidence.quote: Please also note the API Usage guidelines (in particular regarding sub-licensing)

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.description: The organization that offers the service, decides on it and reviews exceptional access requests.

evidence.quote: primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation
is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise LLC
individuals.description: The LLC that oversees the project, governed by the Foundation's Board of Trustees (the text only calls it 'the LLC').

evidence.quote: The board of the LLC overseeing the project are *Ex officio* from Wikimedia Foundation leadership

individuals.title: Commercial Partnerships
individuals.description: The Wikimedia Foundation division that runs Wikimedia Enterprise; called 'Wikimedia Enterprise' until December 2025.

evidence.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise project is helmed by the **Commercial Partnerships** division, which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Advancement Department
individuals.description: The Wikimedia Foundation department that Commercial Partnerships sits under.

evidence.quote: which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Technical Partnerships team
individuals.description: The team whose inclusion led to the division's rename.

evidence.quote: to reflect the inclusion of the Technical Partnerships team

individuals.description: The team responsible for the existing Wikimedia APIs, which serve volunteers and community tools.

evidence.quote: allows the Wikimedia API team to focus on volunteers, teams, and organizations looking to access

individuals.title: Wikimedia Deutschland
individuals.description: The affiliate whose staff help review requests that include substantive access to Wikidata content.

evidence.quote: the request will be reviewed in coordination with staff from *Wikimedia Deutschland*

individuals.description: The board whose governance the LLC is subject to.

evidence.quote: The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees

individuals.description: The board of the LLC, made up ex officio of Wikimedia Foundation leadership roles.

individuals.title: Commercial reuser
individuals.description: An organization that reuses Wikimedia content at high volume in its own products; the customer the service is built for.

evidence.quote: build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content
Wikimedia Enterprise's focus is on businesses that reuse our content, typically at a large scale

individuals.description: The individual or organisation asking for exceptional access.

evidence.quote: **1. Who** (individual or organisation) is requesting exceptional access?

individuals.title: Wikimedia movement
individuals.description: The movement whose mission the revenue supports and whose strategy asked for enterprise-level APIs.

evidence.quote: would feed back into the Wikimedia movement
All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission

individuals.title: Wikimedia community
individuals.description: Community members, especially the technical community, whose input is sought throughout the life of the service.

evidence.quote: We are seeking community input, in particular from the technical community and those who have been involved in the strategy process, throughout the lifetime of the service.
There has long been a feeling among community members that these companies should do more to reinvest

individuals.title: Researchers and archivists
individuals.description: Universities, researchers, archives and archivists who should also benefit from the service.

evidence.quote: but also for universities and university researchers; archives and archivists; along with the wider Wikimedia movement

individuals.title: Wikimedia readers
individuals.description: Readers who meet Wikimedia content beyond Wikimedia's own websites.

evidence.quote: improve the user experience of Wikimedia's readers beyond our own websites

individuals.title: Exceptional access review
individuals.description: The process in which Wikimedia Foundation staff review a request against six criteria and grant access at the Foundation's discretion.

evidence.quote: Requests will be reviewed by *Wikimedia Foundation* staff in accordance with the following criteria, and granted at the Wikimedia Foundation's discretion.

individuals.title: Human rights assessment
individuals.description: The assessment the Foundation undertakes for certain users of paid accounts.

evidence.quote: A human rights assessment is undertaken by the WMF for certain users of paid accounts for the Enterprise APIs

individuals.title: Sales
individuals.description: Selling the service to commercial customers, assisted by Vuurr.

evidence.quote: **Vuurr** are assisting our sales process

individuals.title: Community consultation
individuals.description: Gathering input on the service from the community through meetings, research interviews, focus groups and Meta.

evidence.quote: We will continue gathering input via research interviews and focus groups, as well feedback here on Meta as per our principles.

individuals.title: Wikimedia content
individuals.description: The content and data of the Wikimedia projects that reusers repurpose.

evidence.quote: The focus is on organizations that want to repurpose Wikimedia content in other contexts
how far Wikimedia project data reaches beyond our own ecosystem

individuals.title: Exceptional access request
individuals.description: A request for exceptional access, answering the six criteria.

evidence.quote: please contact <techpartnershipswikimedia.org> with a response to the six criteria described below

individuals.title: LLC reports and official documents
individuals.description: The LLC's reports and official documents, published on the Foundation's governance site.

evidence.quote: All reports and official documents of the LLC are published on a dedicated Wikimedia Enterprise page

individuals.title: Snapshot API
individuals.description: Retrieves an entire Wikimedia project as a compressed dump file, refreshed monthly on free accounts and weekly or daily on paid ones.

evidence.quote: The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file.

individuals.title: On-demand API
individuals.description: Retrieves single articles from any supported project at any time over standard HTTP requests.

evidence.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime.

individuals.title: Realtime API
individuals.description: Streams updates from any supported project as they happen, with hourly batches of changed articles.

evidence.quote: The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project.

individuals.title: Enterprise APIs
individuals.description: The suite of three APIs that return the same data through different retrieval methods.

evidence.quote: Three APIs; same data with different retrieval methods:
the suite of Enterprise APIs

individuals.title: Realtime streaming
individuals.description: Streaming (firehose) updates of every change as it occurs.

evidence.quote: Streaming: Receive streaming (firehose) updates of every change as they occur in real-time

individuals.title: Realtime batch
individuals.description: Hourly compressed files of all the articles that changed.

evidence.quote: Batch: Download compressed files of all articles that were changed, generated hourly

individuals.title: Event filtering
individuals.description: Filtering events by project or revision namespace.

evidence.quote: Filtering of events by Project or Revision Namespace

individuals.title: Structured Contents (beta)
individuals.description: Beta datasets of structured content, also downloadable from third-party platforms.

evidence.quote: Downloading Structured Contents (beta) datasets hosted on third-party platforms.

individuals.title: Article response payload
individuals.description: The structured JSON every API returns: article data such as summary, image, Wikidata QID and licence, plus metadata about the last revision.

evidence.quote: All of our APIs return the same structured JSON (or ND-JSON) response format making it easy to augment one API with another.
API responses payloads include article data such as summary, image, Wikidata QID, license, and metadata specific to the last revision

individuals.title: Snapshot dump file
individuals.description: The compressed file containing everything in a supported project that the Snapshot API delivers.

evidence.quote: Download a compressed file containing everything in any supported project, in any language

individuals.title: Free account thresholds
individuals.description: The requests-per-second and datasets-per-month limits of a free account.

evidence.quote: Persistent need for access above the Enterprise API requests/second, or datasets/month, free thresholds

individuals.title: Wikimedia Dumps
individuals.description: The existing free database dumps that high-volume reusers have relied on.

evidence.quote: For high-volume reusers that currently rely on the Wikimedia Dumps to access our information

individuals.title: EventStream
individuals.description: The existing event stream of changes that reusers use to update their products in real time.

evidence.quote: using EventStream APIs to access such changes
Reusers that use an infrastructure reliant on the EventStream platform

individuals.title: RESTBase
individuals.description: The existing service reusers call to pull HTML for page titles and current revisions.

evidence.quote: depend on services like RESTBase to pull HTML from page titles and current revisions to update their products

individuals.title: enterprise.wikimedia.com
individuals.description: The official website where the service is offered and free accounts are created.

evidence.quote: available via enterprise.wikimedia.com
Creating a free account on the official website

individuals.title: API authorization header
individuals.description: The authorization header Enterprise API calls carry; calls from inside Wikimedia Cloud Services may omit it.

evidence.quote: without passing an authorization header

individuals.title: Wikimedia Cloud Services
individuals.description: The Foundation's cloud platform; calls from inside it get paid-level access without an authorization header.

evidence.quote: Using Wikimedia Cloud Services. You get the same access as a paid account when making a call to any Enterprise API endpoint

individuals.title: PAWS
individuals.description: A Wikimedia Cloud Services environment from which the Enterprise APIs can be called at the paid level.

evidence.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Wikimedia Cloud VPS
individuals.description: A Wikimedia Cloud Services environment from which the Enterprise APIs can be called at the paid level.

evidence.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Toolforge
individuals.description: A Wikimedia Cloud Services environment from which the Enterprise APIs can be called at the paid level.

evidence.quote: from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge

individuals.title: Launch (October 2021)
individuals.description: The service launched.

evidence.quote: and launched in October 2021

individuals.title: Build services for high-volume commercial reusers
individuals.description: The stated goal of the service.

evidence.quote: The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: Improve readers' experience beyond Wikimedia's own websites
individuals.description: One of the three aims of Wikimedia Enterprise.

evidence.quote: improve the user experience of Wikimedia's readers beyond our own websites

individuals.title: Increase the reach and discoverability of the content
individuals.description: One of the three aims of Wikimedia Enterprise.

evidence.quote: increase the reach and discoverability of the content

individuals.title: Improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability
individuals.description: One of the three aims: the largest reusers should find it easier to attribute and verify what they reuse.

evidence.quote: improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability by the organizations that reuse Wikimedia project data the most

individuals.title: Program goal: Content
individuals.description: Make more of the movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, free for all researchers and reusers.

evidence.quote: **Content**: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, freely available for all researchers and re-users.

individuals.title: Program goal: Resource-load
individuals.description: Reduce the need for high-intensity site scraping by the highest-volume reusers.

evidence.quote: **Resource-load**: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers.

individuals.title: Program goal: Fundraising
individuals.description: Give the largest reusers a clearer, more consistent way to reinvest in the movement than occasional donations.

evidence.quote: **Fundraising**: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement

individuals.title: Democratize the data for organizations without the largest users' resources
individuals.description: Level the playing field so that smaller organizations can also work with Wikimedia data.

evidence.quote: there is a responsibility to democratize our data for organizations that do not possess the resources of these largest users

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendations
individuals.description: The strategy recommendations to increase the movement's sustainability and improve user experience, which asked for enterprise-level APIs.
aliases: Increase the sustainability of our movement

evidence.quote: In the Movement Strategy recommendations to *increase the sustainability of our movement* and *improve user experience*
Building enterprise-level APIs

individuals.title: Large companies rely on Wikimedia content without reinvesting
individuals.description: A few massive companies depend on the projects' data, and the community feels they should reinvest more.

evidence.quote: It is well known that a few massive companies use our projects' data.
these companies should do more to reinvest in the Wikimedia communities for the benefits they gain

individuals.title: High barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data
individuals.description: Outside reading and editing, the content is hard for machines to segment and understand, which limits its reach.

evidence.quote: There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing.

individuals.title: High-intensity scraping of production servers
individuals.description: The highest-volume reusers scrape the production servers intensively.

evidence.quote: high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers

individuals.title: Access for all
individuals.description: The project principle under which the APIs can also be reached for free.

evidence.quote: in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*

individuals.title: Non-exclusivity
individuals.description: Any newly developed feature or dataset must be made available to all.

evidence.quote: In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity, any newly developed software feature or dataset must be made available to all.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain libre
individuals.description: Anyone may use Wikimedia content without restriction, including commercially.

evidence.quote: Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *libre*.

individuals.title: Wikimedia projects remain gratis
individuals.description: The full corpus stays available for reuse at no cost; the paid offering is never required.

evidence.quote: Equally, Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *gratis*.

individuals.title: All Enterprise revenue supports the Wikimedia mission
individuals.description: Revenue from the APIs is used only to support the mission, for example programs or the Endowment.

evidence.quote: All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission

individuals.title: Avoid revenue dependencies and undue external influence
individuals.description: Enterprise-scale models must not create revenue dependencies or let customers unduly influence product design.

evidence.quote: taking care to avoid revenue dependencies or other undue external influence in product design and development

individuals.title: Self-funding service
individuals.description: The service pays for itself from a specific set of use cases.

evidence.quote: through self-funding services
Emphasizing a self-funding set of specific use cases

individuals.title: Abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content
individuals.description: Every user of the service must abide by the content's copyright licences, which cannot be waived.

evidence.quote: All users of Wikimedia Enterprise services must abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content. They are inherent and cannot be waived.

individuals.title: Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy
individuals.description: The Foundation policy that describes how the LLC is governed and that human rights assessments follow.

evidence.quote: as described on the *Wikimedia Foundation Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy*

individuals.title: Human Rights Policy
individuals.description: The Foundation policy under which paid-account users are assessed.

evidence.quote: in accordance with the Human Rights Policy and Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy

individuals.title: User-Agent Policy
individuals.description: A Foundation policy that applies to use of the APIs.

evidence.quote: the User-Agent Policy

individuals.title: Decision making rests with the Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.description: Primary decisions about the service are the Foundation's, with community input sought throughout.

evidence.quote: Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Community editing tools are out of scope
individuals.description: Most community editing tools are outside this service and stay with the existing Wikimedia APIs.

evidence.quote: This includes the majority of community editing tools, which will be out of scope for this service.

individuals.title: Faster, more comprehensive, reliable and secure data services
individuals.description: What reusers gain from the service.

evidence.quote: providing data services at a large scale, so that they are faster and more comprehensive, reliable, and secure

individuals.title: Frequency: regular current snapshots
individuals.description: Reusers need regular, current snapshots of the Wikimedia projects.

evidence.quote: **Frequency**: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects

individuals.title: Reliability: dependable, accessible infrastructure
individuals.description: Reusers need dependable, accessible infrastructure.

evidence.quote: **Reliability**: Dependable, accessible infrastructure

individuals.title: Quality: a best last revision
individuals.description: Reusers need a 'best last revision' of each article.

evidence.quote: **Quality**: a “best last revision”

individuals.title: Filter the changes received
individuals.description: High-volume reusers want to filter changes to limit their processing.

evidence.quote: a service that will allow them to filter the changes they receive to limit their processing

individuals.title: Stable HTTP connections with no data loss
individuals.description: High-volume reusers want guaranteed stable HTTP connections so no data is lost.

evidence.quote: guarantee stable HTTP connections to ensure no data loss

individuals.title: A more useful schema to limit API calls per event
individuals.description: High-volume reusers want a richer schema so each event needs fewer follow-up calls.

evidence.quote: supply a more useful schema to limit the number of API calls they need to make per event

individuals.title: Reliable retrieval of article data in structures other than HTML
individuals.description: High-volume reusers asked for a reliable way to gather article data, in structures other than HTML.

evidence.quote: High-volume reusers have requested a reliable means to gather this data, as well as structures other than HTML
